description: Analyze resumes against job descriptions to simulate how hiring company filters evaluate candidates.

shortcodes.description: Frontend form allowing users to submit resume text, job description, and company name for analysis.

restEndpoints.description: Accepts resume text, job description, company name, and optional flags (research company, provide suggestions) and returns analysis results including keyword matches, strengths, weaknesses, and optional suggestions with reasoning.
Accepts analysis results and returns a downloadable file (PDF or text) containing the full analysis and suggestions.

dataStorage: Transient storage for analysis results (set_transient/get_transient with user-specific keys). No persistent data storage; analysis is performed on-demand and results are discarded after export or timeout.
securityRequirements: Escape all output using esc_html(), esc_attr(), esc_url(), esc_textarea() as appropriate
Sanitize all input: sanitize_textarea_field() for resume/job description text, sanitize_text_field() for company name, rest_sanitize_boolean() for checkboxes
REST endpoints must verify nonce via REST API nonce mechanism or use permission_callback to validate requests
Rate-limit REST endpoints to prevent abuse (store request counts in transients keyed by IP or user ID)
All external API calls (if researching company via Glassdoor or similar) must use wp_remote_get/wp_remote_post with HTTPS URLs and check for WP_Error
ADA compliance: ensure shortcode output uses semantic HTML, proper ARIA labels, keyboard navigation support, and sufficient color contrast
No eval(), no arbitrary file inclusion, no @ error suppression
Validate and sanitize any export format parameters to prevent path traversal or code injection
